add_library(bzip2 STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(bzip2 PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Debug/bzip2.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/bzip2.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELWITHDEBINFO "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/bzip2.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_MINSIZEREL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/bzip2.lib"
)

add_library(lzma STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(lzma PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Debug/lzma.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/lzma.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELWITHDEBINFO "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/lzma.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_MINSIZEREL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/lzma.lib"
)

add_library(zlib STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(zlib PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Debug/zlib.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/zlib.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELWITHDEBINFO "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/zlib.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_MINSIZEREL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/zlib.lib"
)

add_library(ziplib_link STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(ziplib_link PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Debug/ZipLib.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/ZipLib.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELWITHDEBINFO "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/ZipLib.lib"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_MINSIZEREL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Release/ZipLib.lib"
)

add_library(ZipLib INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(ZipLib INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ZipLib")
target_link_libraries(ZipLib INTERFACE bzip2 lzma zlib ziplib_link)
